note_schemas: 2.8 curated tool schemas (L-CORE7-2, L-AIH-7): hand-written input schemas and descriptions for the tools AI hosts use most. The generator refuses a curated schema that omits a key the function reads, or adds one it does not read; provenance becomes 'curated'.
note_output_schemas: 2.8 part 3 (9032): output schemas for the draft tools, fin.balances.as_of, sys.whoami and the report families F1-F7, R09, R30 and R31 (the common envelope of bnx.rpt_envelope is required; report-specific keys are typed and nullable). The Gateway refuses an MCP result that does not match (OUTPUT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH); AT-OUT-01 calls every tool with a curated output schema and validates the results (D-OUT-1).
